objective: Distinct artwork systems across products, internally consistent three-view galleries
source: Built-in image_gen; original fictional concept mockups
core: Use case: product-mockup. Create one stunning photorealistic high resolution commercial photograph, landscape 1536x1024 composition. Real physical product and printed artwork with believable paper/fabric/substrate texture, beautiful professional lighting. Original fictional concept artwork, no actual customer work, no watermarks, no thirdparty trademarks. Do not add unavailable finishes or metallic foil/embossing unless specified. The printed DESIGN must be striking and highly specific, with the requested distinct art direction. Do not substitute generic abstract swooshes, curving blobs, semicircles or an Avalon brand pattern. Focus on product, fill frame with breathing room, no montage or collage of photographs.

galleryRecipe: Use each inspected hero as image reference. Preserve exact artwork, lettering, palette, material, construction and dimensions. Alternate: distinct opposite viewpoint or overhead arrangement. Detail: macro view of actual substrate/ink/edge, without unoffered finishes.
review: Compare all product heroes together for distinct subject, graphic language, typography, palette and setting. Compare each gallery for product and artwork continuity.
